messages:
liz_sales: Rivermark wants a short perf validation. Mix: chat 68%, embeds 32%. Target sustained 95 QPS, chat p95 < 400ms. Need CMK (HSM) + audit logs. Can we run on Dedicated?

hamid_eng: Dedicated + customer KMS works. Quantized model they mentioned: llama-v2-13b-q4. For avg seq 72 tokens, 95 QPS -> ~6840 tok/s. A single A10 is tight; recommend 1 A100 or 2xA10.

ian_se: Test phases? cold start, steady, spike? Any soak duration?

liz_sales: They asked for cold-start, 1h soak at target, 3m spike to 250 QPS, and tail probe for p99. Also want a cost ballpark.

tara_ops: I'll open INF-4942 for pool + KMS grants. Need key ARN and grant to redwood-poc principal. ETA ~12h after grant.

hamid_eng: Run config: ramp 5m, steady 60m @95 QPS, spike 3m @250 QPS, soak included. Use continuous batching max_batch=96, KV TTL=600s. Expect cache hit ~20% after warmup.

ian_se: I'll attach a small harness snippet and JSON config. We'll capture per-route p50/p95/p99, GPU util, batch sizes.

auditbot: note: ensure audit export to customer bucket for key rotation logs.

liz_sales: Finance wants per-token/day estimate. Hamid can you give a placeholder hourly cost for A100 vs 2xA10?

hamid_eng: Placeholder: A100 equiv ~$A/hr, 2xA10 ~$2A/hr. With 1 A100 steady -> ~ $C/day. KMS HSM surcharge estimate +6-8%. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.

liz_sales: I'll send NDA and sample prompts (sanitized). Ask Rivermark to provide KMS ARN and grant test principal: redwood-poc@redwood.

tara_ops: INF-4942 created. Will update when pool scheduled.

ian_se: After run I'll post a short results thread and a 1-page summary for AE with p50/p95/p99 and recommended config.

liz_sales: Thanks team, ping me if any blocker. :pray:
